title: mw.partner.route.status.v1
description: What became of one approved partner record version (mw.config.changed.v1 PARTNER, ADR D28, ticket 83) in the adapter that owns the partner's family: LIVE (loaded, its dry-run passed where it has one, it now serves calls) or REJECTED (refused by the route loader, or its dry-run failed; the previous version keeps serving). Produced by the partner adapters (mw-adapter-billpay first; telco and bank with ticket 84), consumed by mw-admin-api, which shows it as the route status in the ops console. An adapter that replays the compacted config topic on start reports the versions it loads again: the latest report per partner and version wins. Key: partnerId. Problems name fields and rules only, never a secret value or personal data. Ticket 97: the adapters also report partner health on every change (PartnerHealthMonitor): status LIVE for the live version (0 for the adapter's own seed, which no console approved) with a health field; a load report has no health. Consumers ignore unknown fields; only additive changes within v1.

partnerId.description: The partner id of the config key partner/<id>.

version.description: The mw.config.changed.v1 version this status is about; 0 only in a health report of the adapter's seed.

family.description: The family of the reporting adapter.

problems.description: Why a REJECTED version was refused (loader rules, dry-run outcome); empty when LIVE.

kamelets.description: The mw-* Kamelets a LIVE version's route uses (Kamelet usage before a -v2 replaces one); empty when REJECTED.

health.description: Health report only (ticket 97): UP; DEGRADED (circuit breaker half-open, or its failure rate over the threshold); DOWN (route not running, breaker open, or the health probe failing); MAINTENANCE (the record's maintenance flag); DISABLED; DELETED. Routing (ticket 98) sends nothing to a DOWN or MAINTENANCE partner.
